items.stem: An AI tool suggests a patient is low-risk. How should a clinician use this?

options.text: As one input, combined with clinical judgement and the full picture
options.rationale: Correct: AI supports but does not replace clinical judgement.

options.text: As the final decision with no review
options.rationale: Clinical judgement must remain in control.
AI can add useful information when used carefully.

options.text: Assume it is correct for every patient group
options.rationale: Tools may perform unevenly across groups.

items.stem: Which TWO practices protect patients when using clinical AI? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Check tools for bias across patient groups
options.rationale: Correct: bias checks protect equity and safety.

options.text: Keep clinician oversight of AI-assisted decisions

options.rationale: Consent and privacy must be respected.

options.text: Assume the tool performs equally for everyone
